# Schedule {#schedule -}

The teaching schedule for **ENVT3362 Environmental Dynamics** is shown below. Seminars run on Thursdays and practicals on Fridays. Assessment due dates are highlighted in the final column.

    padding: 2px 6px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    white-space: nowrap;

  .envt-schedule .due-cell { min-width: 0; }
  .envt-schedule .due-item {
    display: inline-block;
    background: #d64000;
    color: #fff;

  .envt-schedule .row-label {

</style>
